item.title: Secret et silence dans le management des organisations en Afrique
item.content:encoded:
Emmanuel Kamdem, ESSEC Douala

Zouhour Ben Hamadi, ESSCA

Helena Karjalainen, EM Normandie

Konan A. Seny Kan, emlyon business school

Serge Agbodjo, Université de Toulouse

Yosra Hammami, Esprit School of Business

This special issue explores the themes of secrecy and silence in the management of organizations across Africa. It examines how these phenomena shape organizational practices, culture, and decision-making processes in African business contexts.

Potential topics

  • Secret et silence dans le management des organisations
  • Organizational management in African contexts
  • Secrecy and silence in organizational settings
  • Management practices in African organizations

Timeline

  • November 30, 2026: Submission deadline
